description: This file defines a router for currency-related commands in a trading application. It includes command definitions for searching currency pairs, retrieving reference rates, and obtaining currency snapshots. The file sets up routes, incorporates external routers, and provides detailed docstrings for each command.

methods.name: OBBject reference_rates( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Asynchronous function to retrieve current, official currency reference rates for a specified provider.

methods.description: Asynchronous function to obtain snapshots of currency exchange rates based on specified base and counter currencies.
